name: Shadow Fleet
designation_status: Union operational designation; not confirmed as the fleet's self-name.
canon_observations: Operated multiple vessels with cloaking, signature displacement, or related concealment capability.
Used hit-and-run fire, coordinated approach geometry, boarding forces, and distributed command networking.
Fielded a command flagship operationally designated Crown Dark.
Deployed personnel carrying an isolation artifact translated as the Third Silence.
Continued operations near the concealed vessel after Crown Dark's collapse, though centralized coordination degraded.
At least some personnel identified themselves through a translated phrase rendered as Those Who Remained After the First Dark.
unknowns: whether all ships and crews share one allegiance
whether Those Who Remained After the First Dark is a polity, oath, survivor category, or translation artifact

command_model.observed: Crown Dark coordinated fleet movement through distributed living operators and short-range command transmissions.
command_model.boundary: The existence of distributed command does not establish that every person or vessel participates in a single collective consciousness.
